name: ollaya-site
description: Website for Ollaya — a static site (Hono JSX pre-rendered at build time, Tailwind CSS) served by Cloudflare Workers static assets

scripts.gen: node scripts/gen-content.mjs && node scripts/gen-registry.mjs && node scripts/gen-results.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/build-bench.mjs
scripts.readme: npm run gen && README=write node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.dev:bench: npm run build:bench && wrangler dev -c wrangler.bench.jsonc
scripts.deploy:bench: npm run og:bench && npm run build:bench && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.bench.jsonc
